slides.headline: Plenty of households stop reading the Bible together for one reason.
body: Nobody told them there is more than one way to do it.

slides.headline: There are at least five.
body: Dr Titi Sodipo laid out five of them on Sunday.
Each one buys you something. Each one costs you something.
Choose on purpose, not by accident.

slides.headline: A daily guide
body: BUYS YOU: no preparation. Someone else has done the work.
COSTS YOU: you never see how the Bible fits together.

slides.headline: Topics
body: BUYS YOU: step by step training in how to walk with God.
COSTS YOU: a fragmented picture of Scripture.

slides.headline: Book by book
body: BUYS YOU: context. And context is protection.
COSTS YOU: patience. Ezekiel is 48 chapters.
People quote Galatians 3 to argue that how you live does not matter.
Read Galatians 5 and that argument dies.
slides.kicker: Same letter. Same author. Two chapters later.

slides.headline: Genesis to Revelation
body: BUYS YOU: the whole storyline, in order.
COSTS YOU: stamina. Better suited to a household of adults.

slides.headline: A mix
body: BUYS YOU: the benefit of all of them.
COSTS YOU: you have to keep track of what you have covered.

slides.headline: Pick one and set an end date.
body: "We are doing Mark by Christmas" beats "we should read more."

slides.headline: The method is not sacred. The meeting is.
body: Choose the one your household will actually keep.
slides.kicker: And may God meet you in it.
